name: storehouse
description: Repository validation and evaluation tooling for Storehouse

scripts.test: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run python -m maintenance.safe_exec python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
scripts.validate: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run python -m maintenance.safe_exec python -m maintenance.validate
scripts.validate:sources: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run python -m maintenance.safe_exec python -m maintenance.validate --live-sources
scripts.eval:auth:status: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run python -m evals.auth status
scripts.eval:login: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run python -m evals.auth login
scripts.eval:smoke: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run python -m evals.runner --suite smoke --execute
scripts.eval:routing: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run python -m evals.runner --suite routing --execute
scripts.eval:behavior: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run python -m evals.runner --suite behavior --execute
scripts.eval:composition: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run python -m evals.runner --suite composition --execute
scripts.eval:security: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run python -m evals.runner --suite security --execute
scripts.eval:compare: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run python -m evals.runner --suite compare --execute
scripts.eval:full: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run python -m evals.runner --suite full --execute
